change: A shared-service timeout, server error or unreadable response for a mutating HTTP request is now non-retryable and outcome_unknown. Unhandled handler transport errors use the existing read-only tool classification; reads retain their prior retry behavior.

initial_after.finding: Function-size limit exceeded; extracted HTTP-status mapping without raising limits.

limitations: Classification is not a durable duplicate barrier.
Generic provider-specific reconciliation and recovery of interrupted goal controls remain open.
Arbitrary handlers returning their own error dictionaries and external adapters need separate coverage.
